description: This file contains the implementation of a LogWrapper class that wraps Android's native Log utility, providing a linked list node interface for log message handling and forwarding.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A class that wraps Android's Log utility and implements LogNode for chainable logging.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with the specified priority, tag, message, and optional throwable; then forwards to the next LogNode if present.
